Veterans Benefits: North Carolina fully exempts military retirement pay from state income tax beginning tax year 2021 (Session Law 2021-180) for retirees with 20+ years or medical retirement and eligible survivors. The state also excludes the first $45,000 of assessed home value for 100% permanently and totally service-connected disabled veterans and eligible surviving spouses.

Description: Goldsboro is an affordable eastern North Carolina city built around Seymour Johnson Air Force Base (4th Fighter Wing, F-15E Strike Eagle, and air refueling). It offers an in-city VA outpatient clinic, North Carolina's exemption of military retirement pay, and low housing costs. Tradeoffs include a high crime rate, humid summers with hurricane exposure, and no local Costco.
